name: SCSPRVB
description: YMF292 SCSP 44.1 kHz programmable DSP reverb with PACK/UNPACK floating-point delay RAM compression, Hadamard FDN tank, and 5 presets.

params.name: Mode
params.explanation: Sega Saturn SCSP reverb space (Room, Hall, Cathedral, Glass, Cave).

params.name: PreD
params.explanation: Pre-delay before the SCSP reverb tank (0..85 ms).

params.name: Damp
params.explanation: High-frequency absorption inside the SCSP feedback matrix (0 = bright, 100 = dark).

params.name: Pack
params.explanation: SCSP PACK/UNPACK floating-point delay RAM quantization grit (0 = clean 24-bit, 50 = authentic 11-bit mantissa, 100 = crushed 6-bit).

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Dry/Wet blend (0 = dry, 50 = balanced, 100 = 100% wet SCSP tank).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Master output level (80 is unity gain).

params.name: ON/OFF
params.explanation: LATCH: normal toggle. UNLATCH: momentary while held.
